name: Dasotraline
summary: Dasotraline (INN; former developmental code name SEP-225,289) is a serotonin-norepinephrine-dopamine reuptake inhibitor (SNDRI) that was under development by Sunovion for the treatment of attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) and binge eating disorder (BED).

pharmacology.text: Dasotraline (INN; former developmental code name SEP-225,289) is a serotonin-norepinephrine-dopamine reuptake inhibitor (SNDRI) that was under development by Sunovion for the treatment of attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) and binge eating disorder (BED).

uses.text: Dasotraline (INN; former developmental code name SEP-225,289) is a serotonin-norepinephrine-dopamine reuptake inhibitor (SNDRI) that was under development by Sunovion for the treatment of attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) and binge eating disorder (BED).

summaryZh: 達索曲林，是一種血清素-去甲腎上腺素-多巴胺再攝取抑制劑，由Sunovion公司開發，用於治療注意缺陷多動障礙和暴食症。從化學結構上看，達索曲林是去甲舍曲林的差向異構體，而去甲舍曲林是已上市的選擇性5-羥色胺再攝取抑制劑抗抑鬱藥舍曲林的活性代謝物。
summaryZhHans: 达索曲林，是一种血清素-去甲肾上腺素-多巴胺再摄取抑制剂，由Sunovion公司开发，用于治疗注意缺陷多动障碍和暴食症。从化学结构上看，达索曲林是去甲舍曲林的差向异构体，而去甲舍曲林是已上市的选择性5-羟色胺再摄取抑制剂抗抑郁药舍曲林的活性代谢物。

sideEffects.en: In trials the most common effects were sleeplessness, dry mouth, loss of appetite, nausea and anxiety.
sideEffects.zh: 在試驗中，最常見的作用是失眠、口乾、食慾減退、噁心與焦慮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 在试验中，最常见的作用是失眠、口干、食欲减退、恶心与焦虑。

fact.en: Dasotraline is a mirror-image relative of desmethylsertraline, the main breakdown product of the antidepressant sertraline. This change in shape gives it strong action on dopamine and noradrenaline as well as serotonin.
fact.zh: 達索曲林是抗憂鬱藥舍曲林主要代謝物去甲基舍曲林的立體異構物。這個形狀上的差異，讓它除了作用於血清素，也強力作用於多巴胺與正腎上腺素。
fact.zhHans: 达索曲林是抗忧郁药舍曲林主要代谢物去甲基舍曲林的立体异构物。这个形状上的差异，让它除了作用于血清素，也强力作用于多巴胺与正肾上腺素。
